pantheon.domains_summary: Qhavar is supreme lord of ordered conquest, oath, and the high winds that guide the people.

pantheon.domains_summary: Dorun grants healthy herds, successful ranging, and the field-luck that comes from proper signs.

pantheon.holy_symbol: coals banked beneath a single eye

flavor_text.one_line: A stern sky-faith that binds clan freedom to inherited banners and holy oath.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: Tavraki doctrine honors Qhavar above all, naming lesser powers as rightful attendants of the First Standard and servants of ordered wandering. Priests tie oath cords to banners before raids, migrations, and treaty feasts, reminding chiefs that freedom exists only inside the law of kin and route. Chaotic spirits are denounced as storm-fiends that lure riders into glory without memory, plunder without duty, and rule without witness.
flavor_text.creation_myth_summary: Qhavar planted the first banner in the empty sky and stretched the steppe beneath it, assigning every clan a road, a herd-right, and a sworn place in the wind.
flavor_text.moral_code_summary: Honor banner and guest-right, keep ancestral routes, obey sworn chiefs, defend kin, and reject Chaos that severs memory from freedom.
